title: MOSAIC: Modular Orchestration for Structured Agentic Intelligence and Composition
abstract: arXiv:2606.00708v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Automated data science is a structured model-selection problem. A solution must choose data transformations, feature representations, architecture, training procedure, evaluation protocol, and refinement strategy for a task. AutoML systems automate parts of this process, but typically search within predefined pipeline, model, and hyperparameter spaces. LLM-based agents offer greater flexibility through retrieval, code generation, and execution feedback, yet their modelling decisions are often unstructured, difficult to verify, and hard to reuse. We introduce \textsc{MOSAIC} (Modular Orchestration for Structured Agentic Intelligence and Composition), a structured agentic framework for memory-grounded model selection and workflow construction. Given a task and dataset, \textsc{MOSAIC} builds a semantic task profile, retrieves prior cases and source-code modules, and constructs a blueprint: an intermediate representation specifying sele

translated_title: MOSAIC：面向结构化智能体智能与组合的模块化编排
translated_abstract: arXiv:2606.00708v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：自动化数据科学是一个结构化的模型选择问题。一个解决方案必须为任务选择数据转换、特征表示、架构、训练过程、评估协议和优化策略。AutoML系统自动化了这一过程的某些部分，但通常在预定义的流水线、模型和超参数空间内进行搜索。基于LLM的智能体通过检索、代码生成和执行反馈提供了更大的灵活性，但其建模决策往往缺乏结构化、难以验证且难以重用。我们引入了MOSAIC（面向结构化智能体智能与组合的模块化编排），这是一个用于记忆基础模型选择和工作流构建的结构化智能体框架。给定任务和数据集，MOSAIC构建一个语义任务概要，检索先前案例和源代码模块，并构建一个蓝图：一种指定选择的中间表示。
tldr: 本文提出了MOSAIC框架，通过结构化语义任务分析和记忆检索来构建可验证、可重用的模型选择工作流，解决了LLM智能体在自动化数据科学中决策缺乏结构性的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MOSAIC, a structured agentic framework that builds verifiable and reusable model-selection workflows through semantic task profiling and memory retrieval, addressing the lack of structure in LLM-based agent decision-making for automated data science.
